tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Eight states are suing OpenAI over safety concerns, as reported by Fox Business, with Iowa's Attorney General Brenna Bird explaining the case.
Germany will unveil an Nvidia artificial intelligence agreement next week, according to government sources reported by Reuters.
China's commerce ministry is proposing artificial intelligence technology export controls to ensure safety and encourage open-source development and sharing, reported by Global Times.
Fed Chair Warsh signals artificial intelligence will follow a rough path but create wealth, with a rate hold and Korea-U.S. first joint financial talks confirmed by Seoul Economic Daily.
Accenture is capping central funding for Claude artificial intelligence at $29 per employee per month, as reported by HR Katha.
Free every hour.
